test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: which of the following statements is NOT correct ?

options.text: Uttar Pradesh is the largest producer of sugarcane in India.
Kerala is the largest producer of rubber in India.
Punjab is the largest producer of wheat in India.
Assam is the largest producer of tea in India.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Punjab is the largest producer of wheat in India.**__

• **Uttar Pradesh** is the largest producer of sugarcane in India.
